doc.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08

chapter: Eureka Brass Band and Sonny Henry
title: Joining the Eureka Band and playing for Louis Armstrong's 1931 return
summary: Warner recounts getting into the Eureka, Buddy Petit's funeral and meeting Louis Armstrong at the depot.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong
